_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for Tonga.

910.name: Early Settlement of Tonga
910.description: Lapita peoples settle Tongatapu and Ha'apai; among earliest Polynesian settlements.

sub_clusters.name: Lapita Arrival in Tonga
sub_clusters.description: Lapita pottery sites on Tongatapu; Nukuleka site — possible Polynesian origin point.

920.name: Tu'i Tonga Empire
920.description: Maritime empire spanning from Fiji to Samoa to Niue; one of Pacific's great powers.

sub_clusters.name: Rise of the Tu'i Tonga
sub_clusters.description: 'Aho'eitu mythological first Tu'i Tonga; sacred kingship established.

sub_clusters.name: Maritime Empire at Peak
sub_clusters.description: Tribute networks to Fiji, Samoa, Uvea, Futuna, Niue, Rotuma; Mu'a as capital.

sub_clusters.name: Ha'amonga 'a Maui Trilithon
sub_clusters.description: Massive coral stone trilithon; possibly astronomical gateway; 'Stonehenge of the Pacific'.

sub_clusters.name: Royal Tombs at Lapaha (Langi)
sub_clusters.description: Stepped stone burial platforms for Tu'i Tonga; megalithic construction.

920.name: Tu'i Ha'atakalaua and Tu'i Kanokupolu
920.description: Power shifts from sacred Tu'i Tonga to secular Tu'i Kanokupolu lineage.

sub_clusters.name: Dual and Triple Kingship
sub_clusters.description: Three parallel royal lines; Tu'i Kanokupolu gains political power.

930.name: European Contact
930.description: Dutch, British explorers; Cook's 'Friendly Islands'; missionaries arrive.

sub_clusters.name: Schouten and Le Maire (1616)
sub_clusters.description: First European contact; Dutch traders sight northern Tonga.

sub_clusters.name: Cook's 'Friendly Islands'
sub_clusters.description: Three Cook voyages visit; names Tonga 'the Friendly Islands'; nearly assassinated at feast.

sub_clusters.name: Wesleyan Missionaries
sub_clusters.description: Methodist missions; Taufa'ahau (George Tupou I) converts; reshapes Tongan society.

940.name: Tupou Dynasty and Modern Kingdom
940.description: George Tupou I unifies Tonga; constitutional monarchy; maintains independence.

sub_clusters.name: George Tupou I Unifies Tonga
sub_clusters.description: Christian king conquers rival chiefs; abolishes serfdom; establishes constitutional monarchy 1875.

sub_clusters.name: Constitution of 1875
sub_clusters.description: Pacific's first written constitution; Shirley Baker advises; emancipation of commoners.

sub_clusters.name: Treaty of Friendship with Britain
sub_clusters.description: Protected state but never colonised; Tonga retains sovereignty — unique in Pacific.

950.name: Twentieth Century Tonga
950.description: Queen Salote's long reign; WWII; modernisation while preserving tradition.

sub_clusters.name: Queen Salote's Reign
sub_clusters.description: 47-year reign; beloved figure; 1953 London coronation fame; cultural preservation.

sub_clusters.name: Tonga in World War II
sub_clusters.description: US and NZ military base on Tongatapu; Tongan volunteers serve.

950.name: Full Independence
950.description: Treaty of Friendship ends; Tonga joins Commonwealth and United Nations.

sub_clusters.name: Full Sovereignty (1970)
sub_clusters.description: British protected state status ends; King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV; joins UN.

960.name: Pro-Democracy Movement
960.description: Push for democratic reform in one of Pacific's last absolute monarchies.

sub_clusters.name: Pro-Democracy Campaign
sub_clusters.description: Akilisi Pohiva leads reform movement; media freedom; commoner representation.

sub_clusters.name: Nuku'alofa Riots (2006)
sub_clusters.description: Pro-democracy riots; 80% of CBD destroyed; 8 killed; catalyst for reform.

sub_clusters.name: Democratic Reform (2010)
sub_clusters.description: Constitutional amendments; majority elected parliament; king retains reserve powers.

960.name: Contemporary Tonga
960.description: Hunga Tonga eruption; rugby culture; diaspora; climate vulnerability.

sub_clusters.name: Hunga Tonga–Hunga Ha'apai Eruption (2022)
sub_clusters.description: Massive submarine eruption; tsunami; severed undersea cable; global atmospheric effects.

sub_clusters.name: Tongan Diaspora and Culture
sub_clusters.description: Large communities in NZ, Australia, US; remittance economy; rugby prominence.

unassigned_events.note: Events in events.json not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
